<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 134.10955, typical for a protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈133.102 Da. An isotopic M+1 peak at ~11 % of the base intensity suggests about 10 carbon atoms (≈1.1 % per ¹³C). A formula with 10 carbons and a total mass of 133.102 Da is C₁₀H₁₃ (10 × 12.000 + 13 × 1.007825 = 133.102 Da). No oxygen or other heteroatoms are required, so the formula fits the observed mass and isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13O0</final_answer>
